prompts.mosshog: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape character-design sheet for an original Wildbond monster-collecting RPG, 1536x1024 preferred. Image 1 is the approved identity reference: use ONLY its LEFT moss boar as Mosshog; do not use the other two creatures. This is a FAMILY CONCEPT BOARD, not a sprite atlas. Four large, clearly separated panels in a clean 2 by 2 grid on warm off-white paper with restrained pale-green dividers, no scenery or UI. Exact title: MOSSHOG FAMILY. Label panels top-left MOSSHOG / BASE; top-right THICKETBOAR / MIDDLE; bottom-left THORNBACK / FINAL; bottom-right MEGA THORNBACK / TEMPORARY FORM. Exactly one complete full-body character per panel, all ears, plants, tusks and feet fully inside clear margins; consistent three-quarter view and upper-left light. Polished expressive monster-anime game concept art: strong dark outlines, clean large cel-shaded shapes, restrained flat color palette, no photoreal fur or painterly speckles. The images must read as collectible fantasy characters with personalities and anatomy, not mundane boars with random decorations. Preserve approved Mosshog: compact stout moss-green pig, huge dark snout, cream cheeks/belly, pink-inside leaf ears, knowing eyes/eyebrows, short ivory tusks, cloven hooves and curled tail; a moss garden with a few cream daisies and ONE crooked two-leaf sapling grows organically on its shoulders/back. BASE is the same approved recognizable baby with stubborn-but-tender expression, no redesign. MIDDLE Thicketboar is a visibly adolescent boar: longer body and legs, scruffy uneven leaf mantle, two lopsided young saplings, modest growing tusks, bold adolescent scowl; do not give it the mature canopy. FINAL Thornback is a powerful sturdy four-legged boar and a gentle grove guardian: broad cream muzzle with recognizable dark snout/eyes, larger elegant curved tusks, strong planted hooves, compact woody shoulder ridge from which a single broad low living tree canopy grows, daisies and a visible small empty nesting hollow among its root branches. The canopy must be attached and supported, not a tree floating above it; its face and body remain very visible. MEGA THORNBACK is the same final boar transformed temporarily, not an extra baby evolution: lower heavier stance, swept-back root-and-leaf shoulder mantle, wider layered twin-arched canopy with ivory-gold blossoms, dramatic forward-curved tusks and cream bark markings that repeat its original cheek shape, fierce protective eyes. It is a flowering ancient-grove guardian with clear new silhouette; don't merely add more leaves. No deer antlers, no elephant trunk, no biped/human hands, clothing, weapons, mechanical armor, random crystals or unrelated glowing sigils. Maintain leaf-ear/dark-snout/cream-cheek landmarks throughout all four forms. No invented type labels, stats or evolution level text.
prompts.ripplet: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape character-design sheet for an original Wildbond monster-collecting RPG, 1536x1024 preferred. Image 1 is the approved identity reference: use ONLY its CENTER turquoise river lizard as Ripplet. Image 2 is the companion Mosshog family sheet: match its clean 2x2 board presentation and cel-shaded illustration treatment, not its anatomy. FAMILY CONCEPT BOARD, not a sprite atlas. Four large separated panels on warm off-white paper with pale blue dividers, no scene or UI. Exact title: RIPPLET FAMILY. Panel labels top-left RIPPLET / BASE; top-right RIVERWISP / MIDDLE; bottom-left TIDEWYRM / FINAL; bottom-right MEGA TIDEWYRM / TEMPORARY FORM. Exactly one complete creature per panel, ample clear gaps, consistent three-quarter view and upper-left lighting, every fin/tail/foot entirely inside the frame. Expressive monster-anime concept art, strong dark outlines, clean flat cel shades and compact shapes that can become readable sprites. No realistic animal rendering or fine scales. BASE reproduces the approved small turquoise river lizard: large expressive golden eyes, cream muzzle/belly, two small fangs, dark blue swept head fin, broad blue-and-white wave-shaped frill, yellow cheek spot, three-finger forehands, broad three-toed feet, thick curled tail with a blue wave tip. Curious delighted upright/balancing stance and mischievous bubble-blowing personality. MIDDLE Riverwisp is the same creature in an awkward adolescent stage, visibly longer legs and tail, slimmer body, developing blue forelimb fins and a drooping partly folded wave frill; same face, golden eye/cheek spot/cream jaw landmarks; confident expression trying to be regal, not a separate unrelated sea animal. FINAL Tidewyrm is an elegant powerful river DRAGON with FOUR clear weight-bearing legs and a long flowing muscular reptile body, not a snake or eel. Keep Ripplet's recognizable playful face, gold eyes, cream muzzle/underside, blue head crest and thick curved tail. Its neck frill unfurls into a dramatic continuous blue-and-white curling wave crown, matching forelimb fin cuffs and a flowing ridge down its back. It should look proudly capable and kind, not a generic crocodile. MEGA TIDEWYRM transforms the same final dragon into a master of a tidal current: stronger arched shoulders, broad fin forelimbs, swept double wave-crown frill with pale foam tips, a long S-shaped blue-white dorsal crest and a powerful spiral wave-shaped tail, focused knowing eyes. Preserve four legs and a tangible connected frill; all dramatic water shapes grow from its anatomy as fins, NOT floating water rings hiding the body. Distinguish it from the normal final by crown/stance/tail silhouette, not only size or glow. No wings, humanoid armor, weapons, extra heads/limbs, mustache whiskers, excessive neck stretching, unrelated jewelry or detached effect clutter. Keep gold-eye, cheek spot, cream face and wave-frill landmarks in all four stages. No type labels, stats or level text.
prompts.cindercub: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape character-design sheet for an original Wildbond monster-collecting RPG, 1536x1024 preferred. Image 1 is the approved identity reference: use ONLY its RIGHT ember wolf as Cindercub. Image 2 is the companion Mosshog family sheet: match its clean 2x2 board presentation and cel-shaded concept-art treatment. This is a FAMILY CONCEPT BOARD, not a sprite atlas. Warm off-white paper, pale rust dividers, no scenery or UI. Exact title: CINDERCUB FAMILY. Four large separated panels labeled top-left CINDERCUB / BASE; top-right SMOULDERPUP / MIDDLE; bottom-left BLAZEFANG / FINAL; bottom-right MEGA BLAZEFANG / TEMPORARY FORM. Exactly one complete full-body creature per panel, every ear, tail flame and paw inside clear margins, consistent three-quarter view and upper-left light. Expressive collectible monster-anime game art, strong dark outlines, large cel-shaded color blocks and a controlled charcoal/brown/cream/ember-orange/gold palette. Personality and graphic silhouettes, never realistic fur or ordinary dogs. BASE is the approved cocky four-legged wolf puppy: enormous pointed charcoal ears with ember-orange inner ear, amber eyes, bold eyebrows, cream cheeks/muzzle/chest, broad orange forehead blaze and back ember patches, chunky paws, bushy upcurved flame-tipped tail; playful confident grin, banked warm embers rather than a full adult fire mane. MIDDLE Smoulderpup is an unmistakable gawky adolescent wolf with longer legs, oversized paws/ears it hasn't grown into, scruffy uneven shoulder ruff, thin orange ember seams down its spine and a modest smoldering tail; determined eager expression, same cheek/forehead blaze/eye landmarks. FINAL Blazefang is a proudly grounded fast four-legged ember wolf with the same recognizable face, strong athletic frame, pronounced cream chest, elegant glowing fangs and a spectacular living FLAME MANE opening from the shoulder ruff like a swept crown; its ear tips remain clearly wolf-shaped, long tail ends in a single coherent flame plume. The body is charcoal with broad warm ember chevrons, no lava-crack clutter. Noble and warm rather than snarling evil. MEGA BLAZEFANG is the same final wolf transformed into a fierce protective hearth guardian: wider chest and stronger forward-driving stance, a swept-back double flame mantle framing the shoulders without hiding the wolf head, cream-gold chest blaze shaped like a banked hearth, black-tipped pointed ears, longer elegant warm-glowing fangs and a broad forked flame-tail plume. Use pale gold only at the hottest inner flame shapes, orange-red outer fire and retained charcoal body. This is a clear new stance/mane/tail silhouette, not merely a larger wolf with more random fire. Make it exciting and memorable while loyal/expressive. All stages are FOUR-LEGGED wolves; no human hands, biped, clothes, armor plates, horns, wings, extra limbs, mechanical parts or detached flame clouds hiding anatomy. Preserve the original ears/amber eyes/cream muzzle/orange forehead blaze through every form. No type labels, stats or level text.
prompts.cindercub_mega_refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the bottom-right MEGA BLAZEFANG panel of this Cindercub family board. Preserve the title, layout, labels, paper treatment and ALL THREE OTHER CREATURE PANELS exactly. Preserve the Mega's species identity, four-legged wolf anatomy, amber eyes, cream muzzle, orange forehead blaze and charcoal/brown palette. The current Mega looks too similar to ordinary Blazefang; replace its silhouette with a visibly distinct powerful hearth guardian. Lower the shoulders into a broad confident protective brace, much wider forequarters with chunky cream-and-charcoal forepaws, retain a lean athletic waist. Its shoulder flame mane forms a dramatic OPEN CRESCENT CROWN: two broad swept-back dark-charcoal mane blades with clean cream-gold inner surfaces and solid orange flames along their outer edges, connected organically to the shoulders, framing the head while leaving ears and expressive face completely visible. No floating halo, no disk, no humanoid armor. Give the chest a very large cream-gold V-shaped hearth bib and intense focused golden eyes; give it a long low arcing tail ending in THREE broad, clearly separated flame-shaped lobes, different from the final's single high plume. Keep the face warm and loyal, not evil. Reduce random little fire wisps and fur texture; use a few decisive flat cel-shaded shape clusters. Broad crescent shoulder mantle + low triple tail + planted heavy front paws must read at thumbnail size as a different form from the normal final at bottom-left. Keep the full creature, tail and all flame tips inside its panel with breathing room and clear outline. No horns, wings, human hands, extra limbs, jewelry, mechanical plates or unrelated runes. Keep the exact existing label MEGA BLAZEFANG / TEMPORARY FORM.
